audio_scope: Narrator only; closing not generated and excluded.

token_reconciliation.declared_698: The approved/preproduction count contract and the code-labeled whitespace_split tokenizer both yield 698.
token_reconciliation.local_unicode_698: The code-labeled local_unicode_internal_hyphen_apostrophe tokenizer also yields 698.
token_reconciliation.immutable_qa_700: The immutable independent audio QA reports 700 under its own Unicode/punctuation normalization. Its exact tokenizer implementation is not copied or inferred here; this is a recorded tokenizer variance, not two missing source words.
token_reconciliation.caption_text_source: All 63 captions use approved source/provider SentenceBoundary text, never ASR spelling.

asr_limitations.handling: The three listed substitutions are the only non-EXACT_NORMALIZED sentence-end mappings in immutable QA. ASR false flags and substitutions are non-authoritative for captions and do not mean approved source words are missing. Use local ASR word timestamps only if a later per-word alignment is validated against its evidence.
